articles.title: Bipartisan Campaign Pledges $100M to Cut U.S. Maternal Mortality Rate in Half
articles.excerpt: (MedPage Today) -- Healthy Moms, Healthy Babies America, a bipartisan campaign founded by philanthropists Olivia and Tom Walton, announced a $100 million pledge to make giving birth in the U.S. safer. The 5-year commitment aims to cut the maternal...
articles.summary: 美国两党 campaign“Healthy Moms, Healthy Babies America”宣布认捐1亿美元，计划用5年将美国孕产妇死亡率减半，以提升分娩安全。

articles.title: This is how dense breast tissue may lead to cancer
articles.excerpt: Breast cancer often grows in tissue that is unusually dense. That's why clinicians flag women with this kind of breast tissue for follow-up after a mammogram.
articles.summary: 内容指出乳腺癌常发生在异常致密的乳腺组织中，临床医生因此会在乳腺X线检查后对乳腺致密女性进行随访。
